landing.heroTitle: Smart Clinical Support for Healthcare Teams
landing.heroSubtitle: Helping doctors make safe, evidence-based choices with peer-reviewed medical guidelines and real-time safety checks.
landing.demoCasesSubtitle: Strict privacy-by-design architecture. No private health information or personal user data is ever exposed publicly.
landing.caseADesc: No patient identifying data is stored in public spaces, indexed, or shared with third-party tracking.
landing.caseBDesc: Clinical records are encrypted and protected by strict role-based access control (RBAC).
landing.caseCDesc: Assistant answers exclusively using licensed internal clinical guidelines with zero web scraping.
landing.pillarsSubtitle: Built with high safety bars to protect patient care and support physicians.
landing.pillar1Desc: All answers come directly from approved medical guidelines and textbooks.
landing.pillar2Desc: Every suggestion links to the exact section and paragraph in the medical source.
landing.pillar3Desc: Automatic checks for patient allergies, drug interactions, and safe doses.
landing.pillar4Desc: When key data is missing, the system prompts for needed exams and lab tests.
landing.pillar5Desc: The physician makes all final medical choices. AI only assists.
landing.personasSubtitle: Dedicated tools for practicing physicians, medical trainees, researchers, and administrators.
landing.previewScope: Clinical decision support system designed to assist licensed physicians.
landing.ctaTitle: Elevate Clinical Decision Quality with Zero Hallucination
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join licensed physicians, clinical researchers, and medical trainees using verified evidence-based decision support.
landing.ctaDoctorDecides: Doctor retains final authority and responsibility at all times.
